name: Rise of Ymir

features.description: Lock in place with 1x–100x multipliers and award a respin.

features.name: Giant Ymir
features.description: Four Ymirs on one reel merge and add up their multipliers.

features.name: Megamultiplier
features.description: New Ymirs build up a multiplier in the bonus.

review:
A Norse 5x4 paylines game about the frost giant whose body became the world – it even opens with an atmospheric poem. Ymir symbols are sticky wild multipliers: each locks with a 1x to 100x value and gives a free respin once wins are paid.

Four Ymirs stuck on the same reel merge into a Giant Ymir that adds all four multipliers and covers the whole reel. In the bonuses, new Ymirs also feed a Megamultiplier. 15,000x max in every mode.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
